SELECT conname, pg_get_constraintdef(c.oid) AS constraint_def
FROM pg_constraint c
JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.connamespace
JOIN pg_class rel ON rel.oid = c.conrelid
WHERE n.nspname = 'cdc_system' AND rel.relname = 'transmute_schedule'
ORDER BY conname;
 ===
COLUMNS: conname | constraint_def
ROW:     transmute_schedule_last_status_check | CHECK (((last_status IS NULL) OR (last_status = ANY (ARRAY['success'::text, 'failed'::text, 'running'::text, 'skipped'::text]))))

ROW:     transmute_schedule_master_binding_id_mode_key | UNIQUE (master_binding_id, mode)
ROW:     transmute_schedule_mode_check | CHECK ((mode = ANY (ARRAY['immediate'::text, 'cron'::text, 'post_ingest'::text])))
ROW:     transmute_schedule_pkey | PRIMARY KEY (id)
ROW:     v2_schedule_cron_expr_required | CHECK (((mode <> 'cron'::text) OR (cron_expr IS NOT NULL)))
